newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG to invest 10 billion won in motors.
newsitem.headline: LG to invest 10 billion won in motors.

text.p: LG Electronics Inc, a unit of South Korea's LG Group, would invest 10 billion won over the next five years to manufacture high-voltage motors, a company statement said on Tuesday.
It said LG signed a technical tie-up agreement with Yaskawa Electronic Corp of Japan for production and sales.
An LG official said the company would sell the motors locally from next month.

He said LG expected sales from low-voltage and high-voltage motors to reach 100 billion won by the year 2000. LG, which currently produces only low-voltage motors, sold motors worth 65 billion won in 1996.
